messages:
Jordan (Sunstone): hi team — kicking off Sunstone onboarding. POC: Jordan. Goals: ingest AMI sensor alerts, produce 2–3 sentence incident summaries, and enable embeddings for operator search. Pilot target: 2026-06-10, scale to 1.5k req/day. Need owners, success criteria, and a short 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): welcome Jordan! I’ll coordinate CS. Quick Q: any non-negotiable SLAs or regulatory constraints we should record now?

Jordan (Sunstone): main concerns: EU data residency, audit trail for model outputs, and a renewal milestone tied to summary precision >= 91%. Latency target: P95 <650ms.

Evan (Solutions Eng): I’ll own the integration. Suggest chat-based summaries + embeddings index. Need sample event schema, token counts, and a short storm traffic trace. Also confirm preferred region (eu-west or eu-central).

Jordan (Sunstone): sending sample schema + 72h trace to S3 in the invite. Avg tokens ~210, bursts to 2k events/min in peak. Prefer eu-central.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: day 2 dev workshop, day 9 ops/runbook. I’ll share a pre-read with IAM roles, allowlist, and evaluation prompts. Will record sessions.

Liam (Security): flag: if audit logs must show per-request outputs retained for >180 days we may need Private evaluation. Marta, please log this as a potential renewal risk.

Marta (CSM): noted. Draft success criteria: - Summary precision >=91% on gold prompts, - P95 latency <650ms, - Stable 1.5k req/day with <0.5% errors, - Security & audit sign-off for EU controls.

Evan (Solutions Eng): proposed milestones:
Week 1: credentials, allowlist, smoke test (curl snippet below)
Week 2: ingestion & embeddings index + baseline evals
Week 3: prompt tuning & latency optimizations
Week 4: pilot rollout + monitoring handoff

Evan (Solutions Eng): smoke curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize sensor alert"}'` — test from your network and confirm egress.

Marta (CSM): proposing kickoff Thu 09:30 CET or Fri 14:00 CET. Which works? I’ll include eng lead, security, product, and legal.

Jordan (Sunstone): Thu 09:30 CET works. Attendees: Jordan, Priya, Evan, Mateo (Eng lead), Liam, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Thu 09:30 CET — \"Sunstone  Redwood Onboarding Kickoff\". Invite sent.

Marta (CSM): CS action items: request allowlist IPs, sample S3 payload, legal contact, and finalize acceptance tests. Any other immediate risks?

Jordan (Sunstone): risk: compressed event payloads may cause parsing variance in our extractor; will include sample decompression script.

Marta (CSM): adding decompression check and a load-test scenario to the pilot plan. See you Thu. :rocket:
